 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Andoni Iraola has handed Trey Nyoni his full Premier League debut for Liverpool's clash with Arsenal this afternoon. 
 The 19-year-old has been named in the starting side at Anfield, as Liverpool take on the Premier League champions.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Nyoni has made six substitute appearances in the league this season, but has earned a start after impressing in the midweek Carabao Cup win over Chelsea. The teenager partners Alexis Mac Allister in midfield for the Reds, with Rayn Gravenberch on the bench.
 For Arsenal, Mikel Arteta has made five changes from the team that beat Everton 2-0 last weekend. The Spaniard has brought Christos Tzolis and Jurrien Timber back into the starting XI after recent injuries.
 Liverpool team to face Arsenal
 Alisson; Araujo, Jacquet, Van Dijk, Kerkez; Nyoni, Mac Allister, Wirtz; Barcola, Isak, Gakpo.
 Arsenal team to face Liverpool
 Raya; Timber, Konsa, Gabriel, Calafiori; Rice, Guimaraes, Odegaard; Madueke, Havertz, Tzolis.
